entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Agent' at any time to speak with a representative.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-8821-4590.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see the order for the Velo-Pro road cycling shoes. I can certainly help with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit right. I took them on one short ride and they're already causing blisters. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key. Just to be sure, did you get a chance to reposition the cleats? Sometimes a small adjustment there can relieve pressure points significantly.
Look, I don't have time to experiment. The shoes are the wrong shape for my feet. Is it a yes or no on the return?
It's a yes, absolutely. I see you received the delivery just four days ago, so you are well within the 90-day return window for our cycling shoes.

I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You can simply pack the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Once our warehouse scans the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. That usually takes about 3 to 5 business days from the time they receive it.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
